									<p>500km of pure freedom across the Moroccan Sahara coast</p>								</div>

					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-24f66f6 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="24f66f6" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Welcome to the Dakhla Downwind Challenge 2027</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-131e7b4 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="131e7b4" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Get ready for a one-of-a-kind kitesurfing adventure from Dakhla to Lagouira,  This unique downwind journey brings together over 50 riders to celebrate the 48th anniversary of the recovery of Oued Eddahab.</p>								</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f6eb2cc elementor-countdown--label-inline elementor-widget-mobile__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-countdown" data-id="f6eb2cc" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="countdown.default">
							<div class="elementor-countdown-wrapper" data-date="1818281520">
			<div class="elementor-countdown-item"><span class="elementor-countdown-digits elementor-countdown-days"></span> <span class="elementor-countdown-label">Days</span></div><div class="elementor-countdown-item"><span class="elementor-countdown-digits elementor-countdown-hours"></span> <span class="elementor-countdown-label">Hours</span></div><div class="elementor-countdown-item"><span class="elementor-countdown-digits elementor-countdown-minutes"></span> <span class="elementor-countdown-label">Minutes</span></div><div class="elementor-countdown-item"><span class="elementor-countdown-digits elementor-countdown-seconds"></span> <span class="elementor-countdown-label">Seconds</span></div>		</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-90c0557 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-parent" data-id="90c0557" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2442b02 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="2442b02" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ab439a8 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="ab439a8" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">OUR HISTORY</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1f555cc elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="1f555cc" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>The Dakhla Downwind Challenge was born from a dream — a dream of discovering what lay beyond the iconic Dakhla lagoon.</p><p>In 2015, Soufiane Hamaini, Morocco’s first professional kitesurfer and a pioneer of the sport in the region, gathered a small group of fellow adventurers. With the support of the Wilaya of Dakhla, they embarked on the very first downwind expedition from Dakhla to Lagouira — a journey that passed through some of the most remote and beautiful areas of the Moroccan coastline.</p><p>What started as an ambitious exploration quickly grew into an annual celebration of sport, nature, and national pride. Every year since, the Dakhla Downwind Challenge has united kitesurfers from around the world to experience the raw beauty of Southern Morocco and to commemorate the historic recovery of the province of Oued Eddahab.</p><p>Now in its 10th edition, the Challenge continues to inspire a spirit of discovery, resilience, and camaraderie — a living tribute to the adventurous soul of Dakhla.</p>								</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ad865a1 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="ad865a1" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;,&quot;shape_divider_bottom&quot;:&quot;tilt&quot;}">
				<div class="elementor-shape elementor-shape-bottom" aria-hidden="true" data-negative="false">

		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-99a5b36 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="99a5b36" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">

		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-436d718 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="436d718" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f85e9b6 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="f85e9b6" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">ITINERARY</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ffa9588 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="ffa9588" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p data-start="203" data-end="480">5-day kitesurfing expedition along one of the world’s most remote and windswept coastlines. Starting in the iconic Dakhla Lagoon, this 500km downwind adventure takes you all the way to the southernmost tip of Morocco, near the Mauritanian border.</p><p data-start="482" data-end="699">Each stage of the journey brings new terrain, from pristine beaches and desert shipwrecks to salt flats and secret surf spots. Expect epic rides, breathtaking sunsets, and nights under the stars in our desert camps.</p><p data-start="701" data-end="827">Get ready for a unique blend of sport, exploration, and connection—with the wind, the ocean, and the wild Saharan landscape.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0efc778 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="0efc778" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8a17f60 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8a17f60" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Each day during the Dakhla Downwind Challenge is a new adventure. Here’s what a typical day looks like:</p>								</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1726d37 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="1726d37" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-82b8781 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="82b8781" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5245f85 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="5245f85" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Morning</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d78972f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d78972f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p><b>07:00 – Wake-Up &amp; Breakfast<br></b>Start your day early with a healthy breakfast prepared by our support team. Enjoy the calm of the desert morning while fueling up for the day ahead.</p>
<p><b>08:00 – Pack &amp; Dismantle Camp<br></b>After breakfast, you’ll pack your personal items, sleeping gear, and help fold down your tent. Everything is loaded into the 4&#215;4 support vehicles.</p>
<p><b>08:30 – Morning Briefing<br></b>Daily safety and logistics briefing with the event organizer. You’ll receive updates on weather, route details, and important safety reminders.</p>
<p><b>09:00 – Gear Setup<br></b>Prepare your kites, bars, harnesses, and boards. Make sure everything is ready and properly checked before launch.</p>
<p><b>09:30 – Media &amp; Photo Shoot<br></b>A quick 30-minute media session for individual and group photos. This is your chance to capture the magic of the location before riding.</p>
<p><b>10:00 – Downwind Start<br></b>Riders launch and begin the daily downwind. Always follow your guide, respect spacing, and never pass the Downwind Leader in the water.</p>
<p><b>Midday – Lunch Break / Snacks<br></b>Depending on the stage length, you’ll either enjoy a proper lunch break in a scenic location or receive light snacks on the go.</p>								</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f377cac e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="f377cac" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f3e2927 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="f3e2927" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">AFTERNOON</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-174bede elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="174bede" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p><b>15:00–17:00 – Arrival at Next Spot<br></b>You’ll spot the next camp by the Moroccan flag planted on the beach. Land safely, park your gear, and shower with fresh water from the mobile truck.</p>
<p>Gear Management<br>After the session, rinse and organize your kite gear in the designated equipment area. Proper handling keeps everything in top condition.</p>
<p>Camp Setup<br>Set up your tent for the night and take some time to rest, stretch, or share stories with the group.</p>
<p><b>19:00 – Dinner &amp; Debriefing<br></b>Before dinner, we hold a short debriefing to recap the day and preview the next stage. Then, gather under the stars to enjoy a well-earned meal.</p>								</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f94955f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="f94955f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Each day brings new conditions, new views, and new memories. Stay flexible, stay safe, and enjoy every moment of the ride.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>

					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1c9e7cd e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="1c9e7cd" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">

		</span>

				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-79611" class="elementor-element elementor-element-64cc9e8 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="64cc9e8" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-20fc61a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="20fc61a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>You can register directly on the website. Once registered, you’ll receive a confirmation email and access to our private group for updates.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-79612" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="13" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-79612" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> How much does it cost ? </div></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-79612" class="elementor-element elementor-element-e2328f4 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="e2328f4" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b5d77ce elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b5d77ce" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>A detailed pricing breakdown is available on the website. It includes logistics, food, accommodation, media coverage, and gear.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-79613" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="14" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-79613" >
					<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-header'><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> Can I cancel if something comes up ? </div></span>
							<span class='e-n-accordion-item-title-icon'>
			<span class='e-opened' ><svg></svg></span>
			<span class='e-closed'><svg></svg></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-79613" class="elementor-element elementor-element-86b849a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="86b849a" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d2e771c elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d2e771c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Cancellations are accepted under specific conditions outlined in our terms. We recommend travel insurance.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</details>
						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-79614" class="e-n-accordion-item" >
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="15" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-79614" >

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dc81fa9 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="dc81fa9" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>The Dakhla Downwind Challenge is organized by Soufiane Hamaini, Morocco’s first professional kitesurfer, with support from New Spirit Dakhla and local partners.</p>								</div>
